fx.Provide(
				config.NewBinder,
				config.New,
				newSentryClient,
				newLogger,
				newPostgresMigrator,
				newPostgresPool,
				newJWTKeyFunc,
				newJWTParser,
				loggingsdk.NewLoggingMiddleware,
				httpserver.New,
				httpserver.NewRouter,
				interceptors.NewOperationIDInterceptor,
				interceptors.NewPanicInterceptor,
				interceptors.NewErrorInterceptor,
				interceptors.NewAuthInterceptor,
				interceptors.NewLoggingInterceptor,
				grpcserver.NewServer,
				puan.NewSolutionCreator,
				newMetricsSubmitter,
				newMetricsInterceptor,
				newMetricsHttpRoundTripper,
				httpclient.NewRetryClient,
				httpclient.New,
				ruleset.NewSelectionValidator,
				newGLPKClient,
				fx.Annotate(
					usecase.NewCarKeyCalculator,
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.CarKeyCalculator)),
				),
				fx.Annotate(
					usecase.NewCarRulesetCreator,
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.CarRulesetCreator)),
				),
				fx.Annotate(
					postgres.NewRepository,
					fx.As(new(usecase.CarRulesetRepository)),
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.CarRulesetDeleter)),
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.CarSpecificationReader)),
				),
				fx.Annotate(
					usecase.NewStartCarKeysCalculator,
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.StartCarKeysCalculator)),
				),
				fx.Annotate(
					usecase.NewBaseCarKeyCalculator,
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.BaseCarKeyCalculator)),
				),
				fx.Annotate(
					usecase.NewNextCarKeyCalculator,
					fx.As(new(grpcserver.NextCarKeyCalculator)),
				),
			)

fx.Invoke(
				initializeSentry,
				migrateDatabase,
				closePostgresPool,
				startHTTPServer,
				addRoutes,
				startGRPCServer,
				startMetricsCollection,
			)
